description:
Welcome to my DIY channel!  I recently purchased on old home from 1950 with out-of-date electrical wiring, a bad roof, a cluttered crawl space, old drywall with popcorn ceilings, and so much more that needs to be fixed!

I plan on tackling a different DIY housing project each week, and I look forward to seeing where all my housing renovations will be in a year.  Thank you for being here!
